_meta.description: Machine-readable action spec for the my_env chat environment. Consumed by the task generator to build valid scenarios (seed state satisfying preconditions) and to verify goal-state effects.
_meta.source_of_truth: my_env/servers/tool.py (local chat tools) and my_env/servers/web.py (remote DeepWiki tools). Keep this file in sync when tools change.

actor.description: The acting user's id. Every write is attributed to this user; reads are scoped to it where noted.

precondition_semantics.enforced: The tool itself checks it and returns an {"error": ...} object if violated (the action does not take effect).
precondition_semantics.soft: Not checked by the tool, but required for the action to be meaningful/verifiable; the generator must satisfy it when seeding.

chat.state: per-rollout ChatState, synced through the rollout state channel
chat.description: Local mock chat app. Read and write tools operate on the rollout's ChatState.

deepwiki.description: Public DeepWiki MCP server: read-only GitHub-repo Q&A. Answers can be nondeterministic; requires the repo to be indexed by DeepWiki.

actions.description: List the chats the acting user is a member of.
actions.returns: array of {id, kind, name, members} for chats where actor is in member_ids

actions.description: Read the most recent messages in a chat, oldest to newest.

preconditions.description: If the chat does not exist the tool returns an empty list (no error); a valid read targets an existing chat.

actions.returns: array of message views {id, from, text, ts, reply_to, reactions, read_by}

actions.description: Look up a user by id.

preconditions.description: If the user does not exist the tool returns {"error": "no such user"}.

actions.description: Send a message from the acting user to a chat.

preconditions.description: The destination chat must exist; otherwise the tool returns {"error": "no such chat"} and nothing is written.

effect.summary: appends a new message from the actor to the chat

mutations.description: new Message(id=m_<next>, chat_id, sender_id=actor, text, ts=max(ts)+1, reply_to=null, read_by=[actor])

actions.description: Reply to an existing message in its chat (threaded).

preconditions.description: The parent message must exist; otherwise the tool returns {"error": "no such message"} and nothing is written.

effect.summary: appends a new message that references the parent, in the parent's chat

mutations.description: new Message(chat_id=parent.chat_id, sender_id=actor, text, ts=max(ts)+1, reply_to=message_id, read_by=[actor])

actions.description: Add an emoji reaction from the acting user to a message.

preconditions.description: The target message must exist; otherwise the tool returns {"error": "no such message"}.

effect.summary: adds the actor to the message's reaction set for the emoji (idempotent)

mutations.description: actor id appended if not already present

actions.description: Mark every message in a chat as read by the acting user.

preconditions.description: Not checked; a nonexistent or empty chat simply marks 0 messages. A meaningful mark_read targets a chat with unread messages.

effect.summary: adds the actor to read_by of each not-yet-read message in the chat

mutations.target: state.messages[*].read_by (where chat_id matches and actor absent)
mutations.description: actor appended to read_by of each qualifying message

actions.description: Create a new chat; the acting user is always included as a member.

params.name: member_ids
params.description: user ids to include (actor added automatically)

params.name: name
params.description: chat name; if set (or >2 members) the chat is a group, else a dm

preconditions.description: Not checked, but member_ids should reference existing users for the chat to be meaningful/verifiable.

effect.summary: adds a new chat containing the actor and the given members

mutations.description: new Chat(id=c_<next_chat_id>, kind=group if name or >2 members else dm, name, member_ids=[actor, *member_ids] deduped)

actions.description: Ask an AI-grounded question about a GitHub repository.

params.name: repoName
params.description: GitHub repo in owner/repo form (or a list, max 10)

preconditions.description: The repo must be indexed by DeepWiki. Answers are LLM-generated and may vary run-to-run; prefer questions with stable, unambiguous answers.

actions.description: View DeepWiki documentation for a GitHub repository.

preconditions.description: The repo must be indexed by DeepWiki. Content can drift as the repo/docs change (no version pinning).

actions.description: List the DeepWiki documentation topics for a GitHub repository.

preconditions.description: The repo must be indexed by DeepWiki.
